verdict.rationale: Honeycomb documents a public API for building integrations and automating workflows. It covers programmatic management of datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs, environments and API keys, and offers a downloadable OpenAPI spec; markers can also be managed via curl. The probe's 404s at guessed OpenAPI paths only show the spec isn't at a well-known URL; they don't contradict the documented download. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API, and endpoint-level and auth detail in the evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API

citations.quote: Build integrations and automate workflows with the Honeycomb API. Programmatically manage datasets, queries, triggers, SLOs, environments, API keys, and more.
You can download the Honeycomb OpenAPI spec to use with your own tooling.
To add markers via a command line tool, use either `curl` or [`honeymarker`](#honeymarker), a lightweight marker management tool that provides a CRUD command line interface.
